By creating an account, signing in or using Cloud you accept these terms, the Cloud terms and the cookies notice, and acknowledge the privacy policy. We act proportionately and, where appropriate, explain the reason; urgent cases may require immediate action. Niway may also close free accounts for any reason with at least 30 days notice. privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Recording locally and uploading to Cloud are separate actions. This policy explains what data is processed, why and by whom.

controller.title: Controller and contact
controller.body: Niway S.A.C., Lima, Peru, is responsible for Kaipu account and operational data. Contact contacto@niway.dev for privacy questions or requests. If you upload other people’s data, you must have a valid basis for doing so; we host that content under your instructions and the service terms.

local.title: Content on your device
local.body: Local recordings, screenshots, projects and exports are stored on your device in locations used or configured in the app. Signing in alone does not upload them to Cloud. When you use an upload feature, the selected file and data needed to manage it are sent to the service. Screen, microphone and camera permissions support the features you activate and are managed through your operating system.

account.title: Account and service data
account.body: We process name, email, verification status, account and session identifiers, dates and credentials protected with hashing. Sessions may include IP address and browser or device information. Cloud processes uploaded files, names, type, size, duration where applicable, dates, revisions, status, quota usage and sharing settings. We also process information you send when requesting support.

purposes.title: How we use data
purposes.body: We use data to create and secure accounts, authenticate you, host and deliver files, manage limits, provide support, analyze and improve the service, detect abuse and fraud, send service and legal notices, and comply with legal obligations. Processing relies on the contract, legitimate interests, legal obligations or your consent where required. Marketing communications require consent and include a way to opt out. We do not sell personal data or use your recordings for advertising, and we do not use recordings to train general-purpose AI models without your permission. Features you choose to use, such as transcription or AI assistance, process the content needed for them, which may include specialized providers.

providers.title: Where data is stored and who processes it
providers.body: We use infrastructure and service providers to run Kaipu, currently including Cloudflare (web, API and R2 file storage), Neon (PostgreSQL database for accounts, sessions and Cloud metadata) and PostHog (diagnostics in versions where it is enabled), and may add or replace providers such as email, payment or AI providers as the service evolves. Data may be transferred to and processed in other countries, including the United States and the European Union, under the safeguards required by Peruvian data protection law. We update this policy when material providers change.

diagnostics.title: App diagnostics
diagnostics.body: When telemetry is enabled in a distribution, PostHog receives an installation identifier, technical events, device or version information and error reports with messages, stack traces and context that may include file paths or names. Kaipu disables PostHog session recording, automatic click capture and automatic pageviews. This does not mean no technical events or error reports are sent. Diagnostics are not designed to send video or audio from your recordings. You may contact us to exercise rights over this data.

sharing.title: Sharing and access
sharing.body: When you enable or use a sharing feature, people with access to the link may view or download content according to that feature. Links can be forwarded and cannot recall copies already downloaded. Authorized personnel and providers may access data as needed for operation, support, security or legal obligations; access is limited to its purpose. We do not describe Cloud as end-to-end encrypted storage. We may disclose information for valid legal requests or to address incidents and protect rights, within legal limits.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.body: We retain data while the account is active and afterwards as long as needed for the purposes described, to resolve disputes, prevent abuse, and meet legal, tax or accounting obligations. You may delete files in the app and request account closure by email. Deletion may not be immediate for every copy: backups and logs are overwritten on their normal cycle. Cloud files may also be deleted under the Cloud terms, including over-limit and inactive-account rules. Aggregated or anonymized data may be kept without limit.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under Peruvian Law 29733 and other applicable laws you may request access, rectification, cancellation or objection, and other rights where they apply. Email us from your account address; we may ask for proportionate information to verify your identity and will respond within the legal deadlines. You may also file a claim with the National Authority for Personal Data Protection of Peru.

security.title: Security and changes
security.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data, but no system eliminates every risk. Do not share passwords or upload information you are not authorized to process. We will update this policy when practices change, showing the date and version and communicating material changes. Publishing an update does not replace consent where required or authorize incompatible new uses of your data.

cloud.title: Cloud and acceptable use
cloud.intro: Space to try and share, with clear limits. These conditions supplement the general terms and take precedence for the promotional quota.

offer.title: The initial offer
offer.body: The promotion includes 250 MB of free total storage after email verification. You can request an increase to 1 GB total, subject to manual approval by Niway during the beta. Recordings and screenshots share this space; the increase does not add 1 GB to the initial 250 MB. It is not a monthly allowance, a paid entitlement or a guarantee of permanent storage. Eligibility, amount and duration are set by Niway and may differ between accounts, regions or periods. Recording, editing and exporting locally do not require an account.

changes.title: Capacity and feature changes
changes.body: Niway may change, reduce, suspend or end free and promotional capacity, limits or Cloud features at its discretion, including for cost, demand, availability, security or business reasons. General reductions of free capacity will be announced by email or in the service with reasonable notice, normally at least 15 days, stating the new limit and its effective date. Paid plans, if offered, follow the notice in their purchase conditions. You may stop using Cloud at any time without penalty.

overLimit.title: If you exceed a limit
overLimit.body: If your stored files exceed a new or existing limit, new uploads and sharing may be restricted until you free up space. You will be told how much space is over the limit and given at least 60 days from the notice to download or delete files. After that period Niway may delete files above the limit, starting with the most recently uploaded, unless you have upgraded or freed space. Local files on your device are never affected.

abuse.title: Acceptable use and protective measures
abuse.body: Do not create multiple accounts to bypass limits, automate disproportionate consumption, or use Cloud in ways that compromise the service or other users. Niway may, at its discretion and without prior notice where needed to protect the service, users or third parties, restrict uploads or sharing, remove content, or suspend or close affected accounts. We will explain the reason where appropriate and legally possible. We have no obligation to monitor content, but may review it when reported or when needed for security or legal reasons.

limits.title: Limits and availability
limits.body: Capacity is total occupied storage, not a balance renewed every month; 1 GB equals 1,000,000,000 bytes. File size, file type, upload frequency, traffic, concurrent uploads, link views and fair-use limits apply and may change; the app shows the current limits. Pending upload reservations count toward capacity. Niway may temporarily restrict uploads, downloads or sharing for capacity, maintenance or security. Restrictions never generate charges.

storage.title: Storage and providers
storage.body: Uploaded files and metadata are stored with infrastructure providers, currently Cloudflare (including R2) and Neon, which may process data outside Peru. Providers may change as described in the privacy policy. Storage alone does not make content public: sharing features determine access. Cloud is not a backup service: keep your own copy of anything important. Niway does not guarantee recovery of deleted, corrupted or lost files and, to the extent permitted by law, is not liable for such loss.

inactivity.title: Inactive free accounts
inactivity.body: If a free account does not sign in to Kaipu for 12 consecutive months, Niway may delete its Cloud files after emailing the account address at least 30 days in advance. Signing in during that period keeps the files. The account and local files are not affected.

prohibited.title: Prohibited content and conduct
prohibited.body: Do not use Cloud for illegal content, sexual content involving minors, malware, phishing, fraud, harassment, impersonation, violations of privacy, copyright or other rights, or distribution you are not authorized to make. Do not probe or exploit vulnerabilities, attack or overload infrastructure, resell or sublicense storage, or use Cloud as a general file host or content delivery network. Niway may remove such content, preserve evidence and report it to authorities where required or appropriate.

closure.title: End of the promotion or Cloud
closure.body: Niway may end the promotion or discontinue Cloud for any operational, economic, technical or business reason. For an ordinary shutdown we will give reasonable notice, normally at least 30 days, stating the date and how to download content; after that date hosted content may be deleted. Urgent security, abuse or legal situations may require immediate action. Local files remain under your control.

review.title: Questions and review
review.body: If you believe a restriction is incorrect, email contacto@niway.dev with your account email, the message shown and what happened. Do not include passwords or sensitive content. Niway will review the request in good faith; its decision on free services is final to the extent permitted by law. There is no automatic conversion to a paid plan.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.intro: We use session and preference mechanisms to make the website and app work. Not every storage technology is a cookie.

session.title: Session and security
session.body: The website uses authentication and session-cache cookies to maintain and protect access. Lifetimes depend on the session and authentication mechanism; session caching is configured for 10 minutes. Blocking these cookies may prevent account access. The desktop app stores session credentials locally through its storage mechanisms.

preferences.title: Language and appearance
preferences.body: The language cookie retains your preference for up to one year. The website stores theme selection in browser local storage until you change it or clear site data. These preferences are not used for advertising.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostic technologies
diagnostics.body: Desktop versions with PostHog enabled may store identifiers and diagnostic state locally and send technical events. This is separate from a cookie needed to sign in. The privacy policy explains what is sent. If a new technology or purpose requires consent, it must be requested before activation; these terms do not replace that permission.

control.title: How to manage them
control.body: You may clear or block cookies and storage in your browser and manage capture permissions in your operating system. Clearing cookies may sign you out or reset preferences, but does not delete your account or Cloud files. Email the contact address for privacy or deletion requests.

emails.verifyPreview: Confirm this email address to finish setting up your Kaipu account.
emails.verifyBody: Click the button below to verify this email address for your Kaipu account. The link is valid for 24 hours.
emails.verifyIgnore: If you didn't create a Kaipu account, you can ignore this email.
emails.resetPreview: Choose a new password for your Kaipu account.
emails.resetBody: Open the link below to choose a new password. It expires in one hour and can only be used once. Resetting your password signs you out of every device.
emails.resetIgnore: If you didn't ask for a new password, you can ignore this email — nothing changes until the link is opened.
emails.approvedSubject: Your Kaipu Cloud space is now {capacity}
emails.approvedPreview: Your request for more Kaipu Cloud space was approved.
emails.approvedBody: Your request was approved. Your account now has {capacity} of total Kaipu Cloud space.

seo.siteTitle: Kaipu Record — Record your screen, without the hassle
seo.siteDescription: Record your screen and camera in high quality, straight from your Mac. Edit, export and share. Private, fast, and no account needed.

roadmap.title: Roadmap | Kaipu Record
roadmap.description: What Kaipu Record already does and what comes next: the public roadmap, grouped by state.

terms-and-conditions.title: Terms and conditions | Kaipu Record
terms-and-conditions.description: Terms of use for Kaipu Record and its Cloud services, operated by Niway S.A.C.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy | Kaipu Record
privacy-policy.description: What data Kaipu Record processes, what for, with which providers, and how to exercise your rights.

cloud-terms.title: Cloud terms | Kaipu Record
cloud-terms.description: Promotional free storage, limits, acceptable use and changes to Kaipu Cloud.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage | Kaipu Record
cookies.description: The session and preference cookies Kaipu Record uses, and how to manage them.

roadmap.heading: What Kaipu Record does today, and what comes next
roadmap.intro: Everything below is grouped by state, not by date. The shipped list is what you already get when you download Kaipu Record; the planned list is what we are building next.
roadmap.disclaimer: Order is a priority, not a promise. Plans move as we learn what people actually need.

screenAndCamera.title: Screen and camera recording
screenAndCamera.description: Record your screen and your camera in high quality, with a floating camera bubble and quality presets that trade size for sharpness.

videoEditor.title: Built-in video editor
videoEditor.description: Trim and export your recordings without leaving the app, with a poster thumbnail generated for every edited video.

screenshotAnnotations.title: Screenshot annotations
screenshotAnnotations.description: Capture and annotate screenshots with shapes and text: multi-line labels, resizable boxes with word wrap, and double-click to edit a label in place.

library.title: Library of recordings
library.description: Every capture lands in one library with previews, renaming, and recovery for imported or interrupted recordings.

watermark.title: Watermark on exports
watermark.description: Stamp your exports with a watermark so shared clips carry your mark.

shortcuts.title: Global keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Start, pause and stop a capture from anywhere, without hunting for the window first.

themeAndLanguages.title: Light and dark theme, English and Spanish
themeAndLanguages.description: The whole app follows a shared design-token palette in both themes, and is fully translated into English and Spanish.

accounts.title: Accounts and email verification
accounts.description: Sign up, sign in, reset a forgotten password and verify your email. Recording itself still works with no account at all.

cloudFoundation.title: Kaipu Cloud foundations
cloudFoundation.description: One library that merges local files with your cloud catalogue, per-account caching, save modes, capacity limits, and removing a local copy while keeping the cloud one.

cloudUpload.title: Finish cloud upload end to end
cloudUpload.description: Upload every capture to Kaipu Cloud automatically, with resumable transfers, clear progress, and retries when the network drops.

videoZoom.title: Zoom in videos
videoZoom.description: Zoom into a region of a recording so the detail you are pointing at is actually readable for whoever watches it.

photoZoom.title: Zoom in the image viewer
photoZoom.description: Zoom and pan inside the screenshot viewer instead of squinting at a scaled-down capture.

watermarkUpgrade.title: A better watermark
watermarkUpgrade.description: More control over the watermark: position, size, opacity, and your own logo instead of a fixed stamp.

imageTags.title: Tags on images
imageTags.description: Tag screenshots and group them by tag, so a long library stays findable.

renameOnSave.title: Rename an image after saving
renameOnSave.description: Change the name of a capture once it is already saved, without going out to Finder.

saveEveryScreenshot.title: Option to save every screenshot
saveEveryScreenshot.description: An opt-in setting that keeps every screenshot you take in the library automatically, instead of only the ones you save by hand.

brandIdentity.title: Refreshed logo and identity
brandIdentity.description: A sharper logo and a consistent visual identity across the app, the site and the installers.
